Thought: To determine which substances consist of atoms of the same chemical element, I need to analyze each option:

- A. Diamond and graphite are both forms of carbon, so they consist of atoms of the same chemical element.
- B. Salt (sodium chloride) consists of sodium and chlorine, and sugar (sucrose) consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen. These are compounds made of different elements.
- C. Sand (usually silicon dioxide) consists of silicon and oxygen, and chalk (calcium carbonate) consists of calcium, carbon, and oxygen. Both are compounds made of different elements.
- D. Sand (silicon dioxide) consists of silicon and oxygen, while sulfur is a single element. These do not consist of the same chemical element.

The correct answer is option A because both diamond and graphite are made entirely of carbon atoms.
